title: El Parque
subtitle: The Park
premise: Sunday afternoon in Bosque de Chapultepec. A kids' soccer game is happening and their ball rolls directly into your leg. Suddenly you're involved whether you like it or not.
setting: A grass clearing in Chapultepec park on a sunny Sunday. Families with picnics, a makeshift soccer goal made of backpacks, the smell of elotes and tamarindo.

characters.name: Roberto
characters.personality: Enthusiastic, competitive about kids' soccer, surprisingly patient with strangers

arc: Ball hits you → Roberto apologizes and invites you to join → First fumbling attempt at Spanish communication → You score a goal → Celebration → Roberto invites you to come back next Sunday
